messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need to lock the newsletter + benchmark webinar launch flow today. Tasks: segmentation, send windows (NA/EU/APAC), webinar CTA split, and inbound lead routing for trial cohorts. Can we finalize by EOD? Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example

maria: Got it. Which cohorts are in scope? My recs: TRIAL_ACTIVE_7D, TRIAL_IDLE_14_PLUS, ENTERPRISE_POC, OSS_CONTRIBUTORS. Also want a small VIP list (partners / early adopters).

sam: Send windows suggestion based on engagement patterns: NA -> 10am PT, EU -> 11am CET, APAC -> 10am SGT. Stagger the sends to avoid SMTP spikes.

jamie: Webinar CTA split: 50% register-live vs 50% watch-on-demand. For the newsletter hero, we should A/B subject lines (benchmark stat vs human story). Example subjects below.

noah: For inbound routing: rule idea — if user clicks >=2 product CTAs OR opens >3x in 48h -> tag as "high_intent_webinar" and push to SDR webhook. Else -> nurture sequence 3-email micronudge.

maria: Also want to use small personalization tokens for subject preview. Example: include company name or feature used. I can run generation for 6 headline variants via our copy model and output CSV.

alex: Ok owners: jamie -> templates + CTA split; sam -> schedule + ramp plan; noah -> routing rules + webhook; maria -> subject variations + personalization tokens. Please drop final links here. Can we have previews before 4pm? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Preview ready for seed accounts: https://preview.redwood.ai/emails/3124000000/seed (notes: missing alt text on hero image flagged, DKIM check passed)

jamie: Template draft uploaded to the sheet (tab: templates). Quick Q on benchmark stat — marketing doc shows "~33% latency reduction". Should we round down for conservative claim?

alex: Use "32% median latency reduction" — QA cleared that phrasing.

sam: Scheduling note: recommend ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 hours per region. Cron snippet for staging job:
```
# NA 10am PT
0 17 * * * send_campaign --audience=NA_10pct
# ramp to 50% @ +1h
# ramp to 100% @ +3h
```

noah: Routing pseudo-rule for engineers:
```
if clicks >= 2 and days_since_signup <= 30: tag=high_intent_webinar -> POST /sdr/webhook
else: enroll in nurture_micronudge_flow
```
I'll open a PR in automations repo. Need ops to add webhook secret.

maria: Subject options (preview text in parens):
1) "See how teams cut median latency by 32%" (benchmark stat + invite)
2) "How ACME sped up inference — webinar + guide" (human case + webinar CTA)
3) "Benchmarks + playbook: faster inference in production" (broad, high intent)
4) "Quick wins for lowering token costs (webinar)" (cost angle)
Which do we prefer for the A/B?

alex: Let's A/B 1 vs 2. Run 20k seeds each region and winner moves to full send at hour 2. :shipit:

jamie: Will update templates with dynamic tokens and CTA variants. Will also add fallback copy for watch-on-demand landing.

sam: I'll set the send schedule and the staged ramp in the campaign manager. Will monitor for bounces and throttle if needed.

noah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/automations/pull/456 — includes rule + test harness. Tagging ops to add /sdr/webhook secret.

maria: I'll push the subject CSV and variation performance test plan by 2pm. Also running a short deliverability check across major inboxes.

alex: Great. Final ask: jamie, post final preview link here by 3:45pm so I can sign off. Thanks everyone — small coordinated ship today. :tada:
